summary: Aicom and Sega's futuristic air-bike chase game, combining arcade racing with end-of-stage combat targets.

entries.title: A.B. Cop

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Sega X Board arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.version: Original Sega X Board arcade release
primary.why: A.B. Cop was developed by Aicom and released by Sega for arcades on Sega X Board hardware, and it never received an official home-console port. The arcade version is therefore the complete and definitive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original arcade version in MAME/original hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official home-console port is sourced.
